s: Well, congratulations the winner. How
did that feel?
No, it I felt good out there. You know,
first time fighting in the small gloves.
You know, I've come out here. I've had a
few fights out here in Thailand, but
first time in the small gloves. I know
my hands are sharp and they're a good
weapon. So, I put it to work and
finished him early in the second round.
So, it was good. You know, complete no
damage. Pretty much ready to go at the
end of next month. We just keep getting
active and you know,
how did you prepare for it? How was it
different in Thailand?
To be fair, I just I don't cut any
corners when I'm training. So, I work
hard. I actually had a different
opponent and then I I rocked up here. It
got changed and then last minute I had
to drop out again. So, I had three
opponents in the last week, but it
pretty much stayed the same. I was
trying to get it done in the first
round, but come out started the second
hard and and and put him down and he
didn't want it. So, we got it done. So,
how are you going to recover that? How
do you recover from this? Well, to be to
be fair, I'm I'm going to go away. I
need I need to go over to the UK, run
around, do a few things, and then I'm
going to come back to Thailand, rip back
into the trainer fight end of next
month, the month after that. I'm
unscathed. Felt good in there. I'm ready
to bang again. Also, big shout out to
Raw. I do appreciate them for everything
they've done. They've they've looked up
they've looked after me better than any
other promotion. Uh, so it was a
pleasure coming and fighting on their
show.
The show's turned out. We've got a good
crowd, you know. We've got exciting
fights. We've got gunfighters here.
Everyone's just out here putting it
down, you know, for the course. So,
let's get it.
We're ready.
